text:
Maria: quick question — the new debug=on traces in /serving produce s3 objects under s3://rwi-prod-debug/serving/ that include customer_id (hashed) and full prompts. Do we have a retention requirement here? I don't want those logs to sit around for months.

sre-bot: deploy notice — feature/debug-trace toggled on in prod (shards a-c).

Josh: short answer: treat them as customer data. Prompts should not be kept verbatim. Our prior guidance was to redact/trim prompts and keep only 30 days for debug dumps unless explicitly approved.

Danielle: can you confirm where the stream also goes? I thought there was a kinesis backfill for 48h? That changes the exposure surface.

Maria: yes — the pipeline writes to S3 and an intermediate kinesis topic (debug-stream) which is retained 48h then consumed into lambda backfills. cc @Ashley who owns the backfill job.

Ashley: we can stop the backfill, but product might rely on exports. Proposal: disable kinesis backfill for non-flagged requests, add a masking/redaction step before upload, keep S3 30d. For flagged incident captures keep extracts in a segregated bucket with 90d retention and tight ACLs.

Maria: sounds reasonable. Example masking config I was thinking to add prior to upload:```
pipelines:
  - mask:
      fields: [customer_id, prompt]
      keep_suffix: 64
```
This would keep a small prompt suffix for context but remove the rest.

Josh: +1 to the masking step. Also request a security approver to disable general backfill — @Danielle can you OK disabling backfill for non-flagged?

Danielle: ok from security side for disabling backfill for non-flagged traffic. For flagged incidents we need an audit trail and restricted bucket access; 90d retention there is fine.

Maria: thanks everyone — I'll open a PR to add the mask step to the ingestion pipeline and update the runbook with the retention numbers (S3 30d, flagged bucket 90d).

Ashley: creating infra ticket INFRA-4721 to schedule the backfill disable and masking change in the next deploy window.

sre-bot: automation — change INFRA-4721 scheduled for 2024-06-05 03:00 UTC.

Maria: will follow up with the PR link once ready.
